lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a rough coordinate-like grid on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper dorsal-lateral region, exhibiting a light-to-dark gradient indicating structural elevation.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a complex, high-contrast vermiculated or 'maze-like' pattern of high-luminance lines and spots.
